keyring's MCP server

keyring keeps the platform's secrets sealed under one master key, and hands each agent session the ones granted to it as environment variables. Its MCP server is for the person and agents managing them: put and delete secrets, grant them to agents, roles, host labels or all, and read the audit of what was resolved. No tool answers a value: only the API's ResolveSecrets, for resolver tokens, does. It is served at /mcp (streamable HTTP, stateless, answering JSON), under a token from keyring token create <name>; each tool is one API request made with it, so it is refused and answered as that request would be. A refusal comes back as the tool's error, in the API's words. The contract is mcp.json; the API's is here.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "keyring": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://keyring.example.com/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer <your token>"
      }
    }
  }
}

Instructions

What the server tells an agent when it connects:

keyring: Every agent's keys on one ring, and only the ones it may use. It keeps the platform's secrets (Claude logins, GitHub and AWS credentials, service tokens) sealed under one master key, and agency sets each session's environment from the grants made here as it starts the session. - list_secrets shows each secret's name, description, version and at most its last 4 characters. No tool ever answers a value. - put_secret makes a secret or gives it a new value; delete_secret removes it and its grants. - grant gives a secret to a target as an environment variable: all, role:<name>, agent:<name> or label:<agency host label>. Of two grants for one variable, the most specific wins: agent, then role, then label, then all. list_grants and revoke (by the grant's id) go with it. These three need an admin token. - list_audit shows who resolved which variables for which agent, and every write, newest first, without values. - Every tool takes the token this server was connected with.

Tools

  • list_secrets List secrets
  • put_secret Put a secret
  • delete_secret Delete a secret
  • list_grants List grants
  • grant Grant a secret
  • revoke Revoke a grant
  • list_audit List audit events

list_secrets reads only

Every secret, by name, without its value.

No input.

put_secret

Makes a secret, or gives it a new value as its next version. The value is sealed with AES-256-GCM under the master key before it is stored, and the answer holds none of it but hint.

InputTypeRequired
namestringyesThe secret's name: letters, digits, _, . and -, at most 128.
valuestringyesThe value, at most 65,536 characters: a token, or a credentials file's text. Sealed before it is stored, and never answered but by ResolveSecrets.
descriptionstring or nullWhat it is, and what it is for. Left out, it keeps the one it had; null clears it.

delete_secret

Deletes a secret, its value and every grant of it.

InputTypeRequired
namestringyesThe secret's name: letters, digits, _, . and -, at most 128.

list_grants reads only

Grants matching every filter given, oldest first. Admin tokens only.

InputTypeRequired
secretstringOnly the grants of this secret.
targetstringOnly the grants for this target.

grant

Grants a secret to sessions matching target, as variable. One target sets one variable from one grant: revoke the old one to change it. Admin tokens only.

InputTypeRequired
secretstringyesThe secret to set the variable to.
variablestringyesThe environment variable it sets.
targetstringyesWhom it is for: all, agent:<name>, role:<name> or label:<agency host label>.

revoke

Revokes a grant: sessions resolved after it no longer get its variable from it. Admin tokens only.

InputTypeRequired
idstringyesThe grant's id.

list_audit reads only

Every resolve and every write of a secret or grant, newest first, a page at a time: while nextToken is not null, pass it for the next page. No event holds a value.

InputTypeRequired
agentstringOnly resolves for this agent.
actionResolveSecrets, PutSecret, DeleteSecret, CreateGrant, DeleteGrantOnly this operation.
maxResultsintegerThe most to answer. Default: 100.
nextTokenstringThe nextToken a page answered, for the page after it.
